# Justin B Hayes

> Justin B Hayes is a front-end developer, website manager, and development team lead specializing in React, modernizing legacy platforms, and building performant, accessible web experiences.

Justin's website contains information about his experience, selected web projects, and ways to get in touch about development, web management, freelance work, and collaboration.

- [Portfolio](https://justinbhayes.com/portfolio/): Selected recent web projects and case-study details.
- [Contact](https://justinbhayes.com/contact/): Contact information and collaboration inquiries.
